text:
Jordan: Heads-up — planning to push a small console UI patch tonight at 21:15 UTC. low-risk styling + i18n tweak. Who's available for smoke and rollback?
Maria: I built and shipped the canary artifact at 20:40 — tag `release/console-3.19.2-canary`. PR: https://git.redwood/infr/console/pull/472. Build hash fb3a9d1.
Sam: I can watch the smoke at 21:15. I’ll run quick QA on staging then promote the canary slot.
Leo: I’ll be on-call for CDN/edge invalidation. If we need fast rollback I can revert slot routing.
Hannah: Pinged QA for a light pass (sanity: login, dashboard, settings) — will report within 5m after canary goes live.
deploy-bot: deploy started by @Jordan — canary slot=console-canary-3 weight=5% — image=fb3a9d1 — started=21:15:23 UTC
Sam: Canary is live. Watching console metrics and SSE error rate. Smoke checklist: 1) load /console/login 2) open dashboard 3) create test org 4) run search. Anything else?
Maria: Add checking: /api/metrics endpoints (token counts) and verify no CORS warnings in console. Also watch bundle size delta (should be +12KB).
Leo: Prepped CDN invalidation command if needed: ```aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1ABCDEFG --paths "/static/console/*"``` ideally we only invalidate `/static/console/fb3a9d1/*` to avoid edge thrash.
Hannah: QA green except 1 minor styles overlap on mobile header — not blocking. Sam, do you want to ramp canary to 25%?
Sam: Hold off until we confirm edge cache behavior. Running a few synthetic page loads now.
Maria: If we need to rollback, steps in the runbook: 1) revert canary routing to previous tag 2) re-promote previous stable slot 3) invalidate exact path 4) open rollback label in PR. I left the revert command snippet in PR.
deploy-bot: canary metrics: error_rate=0.02% (baseline 0.03%), p95 latency +3ms. No anomalies flagged.
Jordan: Sounds good. Sam, after 10m stable, bump to 25% and I'll do full release at +30m if no regressions. Leo — stand by for targeted invalidation if we see stale assets.
Leo: Copy that. I’ll prepare the invalidation and keys. If we see >1% asset-mismatch errors I’ll run the `fb3a9d1` path purge.
Sam: 10m stable. Ramp to 25% now. Monitoring.
Hannah: Quick note — I pushed a small smoke test script to the team runbook: https://docs.redwood/team/runbooks/console-smoke.md — includes the exact steps and screenshots to check.
Jordan: Thanks all — I’ll post a short release note when we hit 100%. :shipit:
Maria: Rolling final promote at +30m if no flags. Otherwise rollback plan is ready.
deploy-bot: promote canary -> stable initiated by @Maria at 21:47:05 UTC — result: success.
Jordan: Release complete. Thanks team.
